subject: Allocation proposal for disputed Q1 charges and VAT recovery
messages:
From: Mateo Ruiz <mateo@stellarnet.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, accounts-payable@stellarnet.com
Date: Sun, 29 Mar 2026 09:12:00 +01:00
Subject: Unexpected duplicate charge and VAT on March invoices

Hi Ben / AP team,

Quick one — we received the March invoice (attached) and there are two items that need urgent clarification before we process payment:

1) Line 12 (eu-west inference) appears duplicated: both the standard usage charge and a regional surcharge were applied for the same 210k tokens. Combined this doubles the expected compute line and increases the net by ~€24,600.
2) The VAT treatment looks inconsistent across the two invoices (one shows VAT reclaimed, the other charged). Our local tax team is asking for a single corrected invoice or guidance on how Redwood will handle the VAT reclaim.

Could you advise if you can: (a) pause collection on the disputed amount until resolved and (b) provide a proposed remedy (credit + corrected VAT invoice) so we can close Q1? Attached: StellarNet_invoice_2026-03.pdf for reference.

Thanks — this is time-sensitive for our month-end close.

—Mateo
Mateo Ruiz
Accounts Payable Manager
StellarNet
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Ruiz <mateo@stellarnet.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Mar 2026 10:05:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected duplicate charge and VAT on March invoices

Thanks for flagging this, Mateo — I’m really sorry for the hassle.

I’ve asked Finance (cc’d) to audit the two lines and confirm whether this was a billing engine duplication or a legitimate regional surcharge. For now, please hold payment on the disputed portion; I’ll get back with a concrete plan by end of day tomorrow.

Quick ask: can you confirm the total disputed amount you want us to hold? I’m working with our tax team to understand the VAT treatment as well.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Mateo Ruiz <mateo@stellarnet.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 11:23:00 +01:00
Subject: Proposed remediation: credit allocation and VAT path for StellarNet (March invoices)

On Sun, 29 Mar 2026 at 09:12 Mateo Ruiz <mateo@stellarnet.com> wrote:
> Hi Ben / AP team,
>
> Quick one — we received the March invoice (attached) and there are two items that need urgent clarification before we process payment...

Mateo / Ben — Laura here from Finance. I reviewed the invoice and our billing logs and below is a remediation proposal that balances accounting correctness, tax compliance, and our desire to preserve the relationship:

Summary of root cause (brief):
- During the March billing run a routing flag for eu-west workloads was not deduplicated when customers had a mix of hosted + private endpoints. That resulted in a duplicated compute line for some customers including StellarNet.

Proposal (three parts):
1) Immediate service credit (posted to StellarNet account): a goodwill/service credit equal to 60% of the duplicated compute lines (we propose €14,760 net) to acknowledge operational impact and expedite closure.
2) Technical reconciliation (accounting): publish a corrected invoice that removes the duplicated line and re-allocates usage across the correct routing buckets. The corrected invoice will also contain an explicit VAT line so your tax team can process reclaim.
3) Cash/VAT settlement: because VAT was charged inconsistently across your invoices, we will: (a) issue the corrected invoice for net amounts, (b) if you already paid the full gross that included the duplicated VAT, we will initiate a refund for the VAT portion tied to the duplicated line (estimated €3,720) or apply the VAT portion to a credit memo if you prefer.

Operational timeline:
- Today: we will generate a draft credit memo and corrected invoice (attached: draft_credit_memo_2026-04.pdf, usage_report_q1_2026.csv).
- Within 3 business days after sign-off: post service credit to your account and publish corrected invoice.
- Refund (VAT) or credit application: processed within 7 business days after we confirm your preference.

Accounting notes:
- The service credit will be recorded as a contra-revenue / goodwill item (GL: 4-120) unless StellarNet prefers a cash refund for the net amount — open to discuss.
- VAT refund will require your confirmation of the paid invoice number and whether you prefer a cash refund or a credit memo for VAT reclaim.

Please confirm acceptance or any tweaks and whether AP prefers the VAT refunded to a bank account or applied as a credit against future invoices. If you want, we can split the remediation across the March and April invoices to help with your month-end.

Attachments: usage_report_q1_2026.csv, draft_credit_memo_2026-04.pdf (credit memo template).

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0144
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Apr 2026 09:32:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Proposed remediation: credit allocation and VAT path for StellarNet (March invoices)

Approved.

I reviewed Laura's proposal and I’m okay with the split approach: service credit + corrected invoice + VAT refund. Two quick guardrails:
- Cap total goodwill/service credit at €20,000 for this case (Laura’s suggested €14,760 is fine).
- For accounting/audit traceability, require a signed acknowledgement from the customer (simple one-page acceptance via DocuSign) before we issue the cash refund.

Laura — please proceed with the draft documents and loop Legal if you want the acceptance language to reference a specific SOW amendment. Ben — once you have the customer acknowledgement, confirm and we’ll route the VAT refund through Treasury.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Ruiz <mateo@stellarnet.com>, Elena Vogt <elena.vogt@stellarnet.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, accounts-payable@stellarnet.com
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2026 16:05:00 +01:00
Subject: Final remediation plan and next steps — StellarNet invoice correction and VAT refund

Hi Mateo / Elena,

Thanks for your patience. Per the attached draft credit memo and corrected invoice, here’s the final plan we’ll execute once you confirm:

1) Service credit: Redwood will post a goodwill/service credit of €14,760 to StellarNet’s Redwood account. This will appear as a one-line credit on your account within 3 business days after your sign-off.
2) Corrected invoice: We will issue a corrected March invoice removing the duplicated eu-west compute line. The corrected invoice will explicitly show the VAT amounts to enable your reclaim.
3) VAT refund / credit: If you already remitted the full VAT on the duplicated line, Redwood will (choose one):
   - Issue a cash refund for the duplicated VAT (€3,720) after we receive a signed acknowledgement (preferred), or
   - Apply the VAT amount as a credit memo against future invoices (if you prefer to avoid a wire).
4) Documentation & acceptance: Please sign the short acceptance (DocuSign link below) so we have an audit-safe trail. Once signed we’ll post the credit and begin the VAT refund path.

DocuSign acceptance: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/placeholder/REDFWD-9821
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/record/7319-DEAL-7319

Requested confirmation from StellarNet:
- Reply with preferred VAT outcome (cash refund or credit memo).
- Confirm whether you'd like the credit applied across March + April invoices or fully on the March credit.

If you’re good with the plan, I’ll get the DocuSign initiated and Laura will schedule the credit + corrected invoice issuance. Thanks again — we’ll make sure this is resolved quickly.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

---
